title: Prometheus — Unified Observability
description: Everything about Prometheus on one board, in the pack's order: SLIs and SLOs, MTTD/MTTR and certification, policy and alerting, remediation, signals, pipeline, logs and traces.

options.content:
### Prometheus · Unified Observability
One board in the pack's own order: SLIs and SLOs, the validation that proves them (MTTD, MTTR, certification, synthetic checks), policy and alerting, remediation, the signals underneath, the pipeline, logs and traces.  ·  pack `prometheus@1.0.0`  ·  **Unified** · [Overview](/d/prometheus-overview?${__url_time_range}) · [Query engine](/d/prometheus-query-engine?${__url_time_range}) · [Tsdb health](/d/prometheus-tsdb-health?${__url_time_range}) · [Slo burn](/d/prometheus-slo-burn?${__url_time_range})

panels.title: Scrape success
panels.description: Fraction of scrape attempts that succeeded (target up == 1). SLO 99.9 % over 30d.

panels.title: Scrape duration p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of the per-target scrape duration over the last 5 minutes, across every target. scrape_duration_seconds is one of the series Prometheus itself writes with each scrape (docs, "Automatically generated labels and time series"), a per-target gauge with no histogram form (0 _bucket series on 3.14.0), so the percentile is taken over its samples with quantile_over_time. High values indicate slow targets or network degradation. SLO 99 % over 30d.

panels.title: Wal corruption freshness
panels.description: Fraction of WAL corruption events per total WAL operations. Healthy Prometheus instances should have ZERO WAL corruptions across any window. Non-zero values indicate disk faults. SLO 99.99 % over 30d.

panels.title: Rule evaluation success
panels.description: Fraction of recording / alerting rule evaluations that succeeded vs. attempted. SLO 99.95 % over 30d.

panels.title: Query latency p99
panels.description: 99th-percentile latency of the HTTP query API (/api/v1/query and /api/v1/query_range) from the server's own request-duration histogram prometheus_http_request_duration_seconds{handler}, buckets 0.1 .. 120 s (measured on 3.14.0; defined the same way at 2.55.1 per web/web.go). The histogram resolves nothing below its first bucket: a healthy server reads 0.099 s (0.99 x 0.1, every request in le="0.1"), meaning "p99 <= 0.1 s"; the 1 s objective sits on the le="1.0" bound, where the comparison is exact. The engine's prometheus_engine_query_duration_seconds is a summary (no _bucket series); the 3.x-only prometheus_engine_query_duration_histogram_seconds_bucket would give the engine-side view on 3.x alone. This is what a Grafana panel waits for. SLO 99 % over 30d.

panels.title: Query concurrent saturation
panels.description: Concurrent query slots currently in use as a fraction of the limit. Saturation above 80% sustained indicates query-engine backpressure and risk of /api/v1/query returning "concurrent query limit reached" errors. SLO 99 % over 7d.

panels.title: Alertmanager notification success
panels.description: Fraction of alert notifications successfully delivered to Alertmanager from this Prometheus. Failures here mean alerts FIRE but never reach their channels — silent SLO breach. SLO 99.9 % over 30d.

panels.title: Tsdb compaction success
panels.description: Fraction of TSDB compaction operations that succeeded. Compaction failures lead to disk bloat and eventually OOM kills if uncorrected. SLO 99.95 % over 30d.

panels.title: Error-budget burn · last hour
panels.description: 1 h error-budget burn rate per SLO: 1× consumes the budget exactly over the SLO window; amber at the smallest factor that alerts for that SLO, red at the largest (spec.policy).

panels.title: Burn rate · 5 m window
panels.description: Fast window: reacts within minutes; pages when both it and the slow window exceed the factor. Hover for per-SLO values.

panels.title: Burn rate · 1 h window
panels.description: Slow window: keeps burning for up to an hour after an incident by design.

options.content: The pack declares 4 chaos experiments (chaos-mesh; staging) but no certification pipeline — a scrape job named `certification` — so nothing feeds MTTD, MTTR or a verdict here.

| Check | Kind | Target | Interval | Assertions | On fail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prom-api-canary` | blackbox-exporter | `https://prometheus.internal:9090/api/v1/query?query=up` | 1m | status_code=200; latency_lt=1s; body_contains="status":"success" | SEV2 |
| `prom-tsdb-health-probe` | blackbox-exporter | `https://prometheus.internal:9090/-/healthy` | 30s | status_code=200 | SEV1 |
| `prom-ready-probe` | blackbox-exporter | `https://prometheus.internal:9090/-/ready` | 30s | status_code=200 | SEV2 |

<small>Declared in the pack's `validation.synthetic_checks`; the pack module supplies the panels that show the probes' own metrics.</small>

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", pack="prometheus", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Symptom alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: State of every symptom alert of the pack over the time range.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="firing", burn_rate="", kind=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="pending", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")

panels.title: Firing pack alerts
panels.description: Everything currently firing with the pack label, most severe first.

panels.title: Burn-rate & forecast alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: Multi-window burn-rate alerts (fast windows page, slow windows linger after incidents) and forecasts.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="firing", burn_rate!=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="pending", burn_rate!=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")
(2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="firing", kind="forecast"})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="prometheus", alertstate="pending", kind="forecast"})

options.content:
| Trigger | Runbook | Automation (declared) | Guardrails (declared) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prometheus-scrape-failures-burn` | `runbooks/scrape-failures.md` | `restart-failing-scrapers` | ≤ 2/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 15m |
| `prometheus-rule-eval-failures-burn` | `runbooks/rule-evaluation-failures.md` | `reload-prometheus-config` | ≤ 3/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 10m |
| `prometheus-tsdb-compaction-failures` | `runbooks/tsdb-compaction.md` | `trigger-manual-compaction` | ≤ 1/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 1h |
| `prometheus-wal-corruption` | `runbooks/wal-corruption.md` | `manual-only` | ≤ 1/h · human above SEV1 |

<small>Automations and guardrails come from the pack's `remediation` section for the platform to implement; in this lab every action is done by hand, as the runbooks say.</small>
